title: Attested Policy Passport
description: Signed, identity-anchored, graph-referenced projection of a KG edge. Crawl-stage (v0.1). The proof is an Ed25519 signature over the JCS-canonicalized body with `proof` excluded.

spiffe_id.description: Source workload identity. SPIFFE is should-be in most enterprises today; this is the substrate the loop drifts toward, not deployed reality.

compliance_scope.description: Compliance requirements this edge satisfies, e.g. PCI-DSS-v4:req-1. Sourced from KG compliance_scope. Ties the grant to the audit control it serves.

data_classification.description: Sensitivity of data crossing this edge. Sourced from CALM metadata.data-classification. Informs blast-radius / authority handling (APP-084).

ownership.description: Accountability + routing context. Not part of edge identity or enforcement. All fields optional.

oneOf.description: authored wildcard — every port on this path is deliberately granted (APP-090)
no resolvable port — not a precise 5-tuple rule, and NOT a grant of every port (APP-000 §6, APP-090)

transport.description: L4 transport — part of edge identity. NOT the app protocol.

port.description: Single destination port. Exactly one of port / port_range / port_unspecified.

port_range.description: Contiguous destination port range, inclusive. In edge_id as port=LO-HI (LO==HI collapses to a single port).

port_unspecified.description: True when no port could be resolved — an admission of ignorance, NOT permission. edge_id uses port=any, but the reverse diff refuses to adjudicate the edge rather than inferring a grant. See APP-000 §6, APP-090.

port_wildcard.description: True when an author deliberately granted every port on this path. Shares the port=any edge_id with port_unspecified — same L4 tuple, same identity — but is a real grant, so an observed flow on this path is conformant (and a narrowing candidate). See APP-090.

port_source.description: How the port was arrived at — the evidence behind the claim, strongest first. Descriptive only: deliberately excluded from edge_id so learning a port from inventory never churns the id of an edge already claimed. See APP-090.

app_protocol.description: Descriptive L7 label(s): HTTPS, mTLS, TLS, postgres, grpc. An array because multiple L7 protocols can legitimately share one L4 edge. Excluded from edge_id so observed L4 flows still match declared claims.

authentication.description: Descriptive: how the path authenticates (vault-pki, mTLS-vault-pki, vault-dynamic-credentials). Security-relevant context for the northbound 'why this path exists' story; not part of edge identity.

direction.description: From the source (initiator) perspective. Ordering of src/dst is the canonical direction.

claim_type.description: revoke = tombstone / DELETE-AFTER edge as a first-class signed object.

tense.description: Control-loop state. will-be = in-flight expansion or an edge on death row.

authority_class.description: The safety split. Contraction is autonomic (low authority, reversible); expansion is governed (PAP-signed).

graph_ref.description: *** THE SELL — this makes the passport a graph projection, not a config file. Required on every passport. ***

edge_id.description: Stable KG edge id. See APP-000: kg://edges/v1/<sha256 over the L4 identity tuple>.

authored_by.description: Who authored the KG edge (distinct from proof.issuer, who signed the passport). Sourced from KG _provenance.authored_by.

authored_at.description: When the KG edge was authored (ISO 8601). Sourced from KG _provenance.authored_at.

expires_at.description: Unix epoch seconds. No renewal → edge lapses → rule becomes a contraction candidate. Expiry, not grace timer.

algorithm.description: Signature scheme. `ed25519` is the crawl/demo default (deterministic). `ecdsa-p256` (ES256) is used when signing with a SPIRE X509-SVID leaf key, which is EC P-256 (APP-080).

canonicalization.description: RFC 8785 canonical JSON, then sign. Signature covers the body with `proof` excluded.

public_key_b64.description: Signing public key, base64. Encoding follows `algorithm`: ed25519 → raw 32 bytes; ecdsa-p256 → DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo. Stubbed single-key JWKS in crawl; trust-bundle governance is walk/run.

signature_b64.description: Ed25519 signature over the JCS-canonicalized body (proof excluded), base64.

workload_urn.description: Canonical identity-system-agnostic workload id, e.g. wl:3tier-pci/web-tier. See APP-000 §4.
